    Independent statements of the main results #

    This file states Theorem A(I–III), Theorem B, and Corollary C of Characterizations of E-finite algebras and conjectures on brick-finiteness using only Mathlib definitions. The proof library does not import this file for its internal development; EFiniteCharacterizations/MainTheorems.lean connects the library's theorems to the predicates defined here, and scripts/generate_challenge.py copies this file into Challenge.lean.

    Encoding conventions #

    • Right modules: Following the manuscript, all endpoint statements concern right modules over a finite-dimensional k-algebra R, realized in Lean as left modules over Rᵐᵒᵖ (Mod Rᵐᵒᵖ = FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ and ModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ).
    • Projective lattice and weights: Lattice A is the split Grothendieck group K₀(proj A) of finitely generated projective modules, and integral weights θ ∈ K₀(proj A) are represented as differences [Q] - [P] of finite projectives evaluated via dim_k Hom(Q, -) - dim_k Hom(P, -).
    • Dimension vectors: Classes [M] ∈ K₀(mod A) in the exact Grothendieck group (cl M : K₀ A) encode dimension vectors, since the classes of the simple modules form a ℤ-basis of K₀(mod A).
    • Representation varieties and King moduli: Over an algebraically closed field, Chart k R packages a Morita-equivalent split basic k-algebra C.A equipped with a complete set of primitive orthogonal idempotents. Theorem A(III) proves that every finite-dimensional algebra admits such a chart and that the three geometric criteria hold in every chart.
